title.narrative: EU-Coffee Action for Ethiopia (EU-CAfE)

description.narrative: To support smallholder coffee producers (including youth and women), processors, traders & their organizations to improve productivity, quality, certification standards, trade transparency so as to increase their fair share and total income from coffee in particular and for Ethiopia to benefit more from coffee trade. This can be achieved by enhancing smallholder producers access to improved technologies generated by research, building their capacities to manage coffee farming in business terms, promoting speciality coffee production, etc.
